raw.rationale: Ciclesonide is a glucocorticoid receptor agonist prodrug whose active metabolite desisobutyryl-ciclesonide has antiproliferative/cytotoxic activity in lymphoid and some solid tumor lines, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days in PRISM it is unlikely to show strong lineage-selective killing; glucocorticoid sensitivity is most plausible in hematologic lineages not listed, with weak sporadic effects in breast, lung, and skin. Published PRISM/CTRP data generally show few selective lineages for glucocorticoids, so probabilities are low across these lineages.
